title: bupleurum lancifolium var. subacaule
intro: Bupleurum lancifolium var. subacaule, commonly known as Chinese Thorny Knotweed, is a plant species in the Apiaceae family. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve liver function, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum lancifolium var. subacaule include its ability to clear heat, dry dampness, and calm the spirit, making it a popular treatment for conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isobutylphthalide, saikosaponins, and other flavonoids and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
